descriptions: Portfolio of Rayan Abdul Cader — automation, tools, design & systems. I help brands and teams build smarter workflows, custom tools, and scalable digital systems.

checks.subject: page
checks.title: Direct page load / deep-link refresh
checks.impact: A chosen URL should open directly for visitors. A bot block or login response cannot prove a broken website.
checks.repair: Fix the route response or deployment rewrite for this exact public URL. Preserve real 404 behavior for nonexistent routes.
checks.acceptance: A fresh credential-free GET of this exact public URL returns intended HTML with HTTP 2xx. Verify rendered content manually.

checks.subject: page
checks.title: Page title needs one clear value
checks.impact: The page title helps people and search engines identify this page.
checks.repair: Set exactly one descriptive title for this route. Preserve the brand and page purpose.
checks.acceptance: Fresh page has exactly one nonempty <title>.

checks.subject: page
checks.title: Review the search description
checks.evidence: ["Portfolio of Rayan Abdul Cader — automation, tools, design & systems. I help brands and teams build smarter workflows, custom tools, and scalable digital systems."]
checks.impact: A description can influence search snippets; search engines may choose other text.
checks.repair: If useful for this page, add one truthful route-specific description.
checks.acceptance: At most one description; any supplied value accurately describes this page.

checks.subject: page
checks.title: Indexing is explicitly discouraged
checks.impact: A noindex directive asks compliant search engines to exclude the page. It may be intentional.
checks.repair: Confirm this page should be searchable before removing only the unintended noindex/none directive. Preserve intentional exclusions.
checks.acceptance: Approved public route has no unintended noindex/none in raw and rendered meta.

checks.subject: page
checks.title: Review link-following restriction
checks.impact: This asks crawlers not to follow page links; it does not by itself exclude the page from search.
checks.repair: Confirm whether page-level nofollow is intentional; keep deliberate policy controls.
checks.acceptance: Document the intended page-level link policy.

checks.subject: page
checks.title: Review the preferred page URL
checks.impact: Conflicting canonical URLs provide inconsistent consolidation signals. A canonical to another page may be deliberate.
checks.repair: Resolve contradictory canonical declarations. Confirm intended duplicate grouping before changing a canonical target.
checks.acceptance: All existing HTML and HTTP canonical declarations agree with the intended preferred public URL.

checks.subject: page
checks.title: Existing structured data must parse
checks.impact: Malformed JSON cannot be interpreted as the intended structured data. Syntax checks do not validate schema eligibility.
checks.repair: Repair syntax in existing JSON-LD only; do not invent ratings, facts, citations, or new schema types.
checks.acceptance: All existing application/ld+json blocks parse with JSON.parse; validate applicable types separately.

checks.subject: page
checks.title: Images need an alt attribute
checks.evidence: 0 of 74 images omit alt. Empty alt is accepted for decorative images.
checks.impact: Screen readers need a text alternative or an explicit decorative choice.
checks.repair: Add meaningful alt for informative images and alt="" for decorative images. Do not infer hidden image contents.
checks.acceptance: Every img has an alt attribute; manually review whether alternatives suit image purpose.

checks.subject: page
checks.title: Review mobile viewport
checks.evidence: A viewport meta tag is present.
checks.impact: Mobile browsers may show a scaled desktop layout. Presence alone does not prove mobile usability.
checks.repair: Review the mobile layout and add a viewport declaration if required by the design.
checks.acceptance: At 390px width, intended content and navigation remain usable.

checks.subject: page
checks.title: Review redirects
checks.impact: Extra hops add requests. Some redirects are intentional.
checks.repair: Link directly to the intended final public URL and simplify unnecessary same-origin redirect chains.
checks.acceptance: Chosen links reach the intended final URL with at most one intentional redirect.

checks.subject: page
checks.title: HTTP indexing restriction
checks.impact: An HTTP noindex directive can exclude this page even if its HTML looks correct. It may be deliberate.
checks.repair: Confirm intended indexing policy; remove only unintended header noindex/none for this route.
checks.acceptance: Fresh GET headers have no unintended generic/Googlebot noindex/none.

checks.subject: page
checks.title: Query-dependent references are outside this sample
checks.evidence: 4 link/OG references with query strings were omitted before probing.
checks.impact: Removing a signed or query-dependent URL can change its destination or asset. This sample does not test those references.
checks.repair: Verify query-dependent destinations and signed assets manually without sharing token-bearing URLs.
checks.acceptance: Owner checks original intended public links/assets through an appropriate safe workflow.

checks.subject: page
checks.title: Analytics receipt needs owner access
checks.evidence: A known analytics script hint was found; event delivery was not checked.
checks.impact: A script is not proof that visits or events reached an analytics account. Analytics is optional.
checks.repair: If analytics is wanted, use the owner’s vendor debug view and consent-aware test journey. Do not add a vendor without approval.
checks.acceptance: Owner verifies expected test event receipt and consent behavior in the chosen analytics tool.

checks.subject: page
checks.title: Crawler access policy
checks.impact: A matching robots.txt restriction prevents compliant crawling; it does not guarantee exclusion from indexing. Restrictions may be intentional.
checks.repair: Confirm the public route should be crawled before changing only its matching Googlebot/* rule. Preserve deliberate restrictions.
checks.acceptance: The intended public route is allowed by the applicable robots policy; no robots file is required.

checks.subject: https://rayanbuild-site.web.app/og-image.png
checks.title: Social preview image response
checks.impact: A missing OG image can break shared previews. HEAD success does not prove image pixels or preview appearance.
checks.repair: Correct the existing OG image URL or restore its public asset. Preserve intended branding.
checks.acceptance: This image URL returns 2xx with image Content-Type; visually verify a real preview.

checks.subject: page
checks.title: Review repeated titles
checks.evidence: No same value found across distinct sampled final URLs.
checks.impact: Repeated metadata may make distinct pages harder to tell apart; deliberate duplicates can be valid.
checks.repair: Review page intent and give distinct pages truthful, distinct metadata. Preserve intentional duplicate grouping.
checks.acceptance: Recheck the same complete sample and manually confirm titles/descriptions suit each page.

checks.subject: page
checks.title: Review repeated descriptions
checks.evidence: No same value found across distinct sampled final URLs.
checks.impact: Repeated metadata may make distinct pages harder to tell apart; deliberate duplicates can be valid.
checks.repair: Review page intent and give distinct pages truthful, distinct metadata. Preserve intentional duplicate grouping.
checks.acceptance: Recheck the same complete sample and manually confirm titles/descriptions suit each page.

checks.subject: page
checks.title: Actual indexing needs Search Console
checks.evidence: No owner Search Console integration is connected.
checks.impact: No directive or response check can establish actual search indexing, rankings, or traffic.
checks.repair: Use the owner’s Search Console URL Inspection and performance reports.
checks.acceptance: Owner verifies the selected URLs and intended search presence.

checks.subject: page
checks.title: Citations are three different questions
checks.evidence: Content sources, local business mentions, and AI answer citations are not verified in this sample.
checks.impact: Source links support content claims; business citations refer to directory mentions; AI citations refer to attribution in specific answers. There is no universal citation tag.
checks.repair: Clarify the desired citation concept. Review source quality, directory consistency, or observed AI answers separately. Do not fabricate endorsements or citations.
checks.acceptance: Owner selects a citation goal and verifies it with relevant external evidence.
